name: FeedbackKit – Feedback Tracker
author: kavitapatel

sections.description:
FeedbackKit – Feedback Tracker is a visual feedback and website review plugin for WordPress that lets you add sticky notes, comments, and annotations directly on any page element.

Whether you’re reviewing a new website, collecting client feedback, reporting bugs, or collaborating with your team, FeedbackKit keeps every comment attached to the correct element, making website reviews faster and more organized.

Share secure guest access links with clients so they can leave feedback without creating a WordPress account.

Features

  • Visual Element Selection – Click any page element to add contextual notes and feedback.
  • Sticky Notes & Annotations – Keep comments attached to the correct website element.
  • Status Tracking – Organize feedback with Assigned, Working, Resolved, and Closed statuses.
  • Secure Guest Access – Share temporary review links without creating WordPress users.
  • AJAX Powered – Create, edit, update, and manage notes without page reloads.
  • Admin Dashboard – View and manage all website feedback from one place.
  • Responsive Design – Works seamlessly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Developer Friendly – Compatible with modern WordPress themes and page builders.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the kavitapatel-feedbackkit folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to FeedbackKit → Settings.
  4. Configure your preferences and generate guest access links if required.
  5. Visit your website frontend and start adding visual feedback using the floating Add Notes button.
sections.faq:
Who can use FeedbackKit?

Administrators, editors, team members, clients, and invited guests can collaborate depending on the permissions you configure.

Can clients leave feedback without a WordPress account?

Yes. Generate a secure temporary guest access link and share it with your clients. They can review your website and leave feedback without registering.

Are notes visible to public visitors?

No. Notes and annotations are only visible to authorized users and guests with a valid access link.

Does it work with Elementor and other page builders?

Yes. FeedbackKit works with Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, Beaver Builder, WPBakery, and most modern WordPress themes.
